# Additional notices for the macOS preview

These supplemental notices accompany the pinned Eclipse Temurin runtime, ZAP
engine libraries and 38 retained add-ons in this Apple Silicon HTTP preview.
Preserve the original embedded and distribution notices as well as this file
and `SERVER_THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`. Component-specific terms and notices apply;
the server's Apache licence does not replace them.

The matching source companion, its exact-version mappings and library
replacement guidance are described in `SOURCE_DISTRIBUTION.md` and
`SOURCE_MANIFEST.json`. This file is a distribution notice collection, not a
claim that every upstream component has been reproducibly rebuilt.

# Supplemental Eclipse Temurin distribution notices

## Bundled Java runtime and matching source

The macOS package redistributes the upstream Eclipse Temurin 25.0.4.1+1
macOS aarch64 JRE. Its native binaries and retained `NOTICE`, `release`, and
`legal/` files are unchanged. Those files continue to state the applicable
OpenJDK and third-party terms.

The matching source companion includes:

- `OpenJDK25U-jdk-sources_25.0.4.1_1.tar.gz`, from the official Temurin release,
  including the OpenJDK source tree, interfaces, native macOS sources,
  make/configure scripts, build documentation, and licence notices;
- `temurin-build-e6ba7dec3d07654074559310376a3ae89da5f4ac.tar.gz`, containing
  Temurin's additional build scripts and CA certificate input files;
- the upstream macOS aarch64 JRE build metadata and source-archive metadata,
  recording source revisions, compiler/configuration information and build
  commands. The source archive is portable and was produced by a Linux build
  job; the macOS metadata describes the redistributed binary.

OpenJDK source revision: `520406d871955300957ef01e406ac2acd0f9b75c`.
Temurin build-script revision: `e6ba7dec3d07654074559310376a3ae89da5f4ac`.

Upstream release: <https://github.com/adoptium/temurin25-binaries/releases/tag/jdk-25.0.4.1%2B1>.

Build metadata and source delivery are supplied for inspection and modification;
they do not assert that a byte-identical rebuild or complete legal compliance has
been independently certified.

## Mozilla CA certificate data in the Java trust store

The runtime file `runtime/Contents/Home/lib/security/cacerts` uses the Mozilla CA
certificate data selected by the pinned Temurin build. Upstream identifies the
resulting trust store as licensed under the Mozilla Public License, version 2.0.
The matching preferred source form, `security/certdata.txt`, is retained unchanged
inside the pinned Temurin build archive in the source companion. The original
certificate-specific notices and the following source licence notice remain in
that file; no new copyright owner is asserted here.

Exact upstream source:
<https://raw.githubusercontent.com/adoptium/temurin-build/e6ba7dec3d07654074559310376a3ae89da5f4ac/security/certdata.txt>.
Upstream explanation:
<https://raw.githubusercontent.com/adoptium/temurin-build/e6ba7dec3d07654074559310376a3ae89da5f4ac/security/README.md>.

```text
This Source Code Form is subject to the terms of the Mozilla Public
License, v. 2.0. If a copy of the MPL was not distributed with this
file, You can obtain one at http://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/.
```

`legal/java.base/public_suffix.md`; its terms apply to the Mozilla CA source data
as identified above as well as the separately noticed Public Suffix List.

## curl certificate conversion script in the source companion

The Temurin build archive also contains `security/mk-ca-bundle.pl`, a curl
certificate conversion script. It is part of the supplied build sources, not a
separate executable added to the binary package. Its original copyright notice
is retained unchanged:

```text
Copyright (C) 1998 - 2020, Daniel Stenberg, <daniel@haxx.se>, et al.
```

Exact upstream script:
<https://raw.githubusercontent.com/adoptium/temurin-build/e6ba7dec3d07654074559310376a3ae89da5f4ac/security/mk-ca-bundle.pl>.
The full curl permission notice below is preserved from curl's 2020-era
`COPYING` file:
<https://raw.githubusercontent.com/curl/curl/curl-7_73_0/COPYING>.
It supplements the retained script notice; it does not attribute that script to
a later curl release.

websites, listed below.

Java projects that are used for building and running Flying Saucer are:


JUnit (for testing)
http://junit.org
License: Common Public License Version 1.0
Using version 3.8.1
Included as lib/junit.jar

Ant (for building)

License: Apache Software License Version 2.0
Not packaged with release; development using version 1.6.x

OpenPDF (PDF generation)
https://github.com/LibrePDF/OpenPDF

License: GNU Lesser General Public License 2.1

SVGSalamander (SVG rendering in demo)
https://svgsalamander.java.net/
License: LGPL
Using version 1, released on the project website

SWT (Standard Widget Toolkit)
http://www.eclipse.org/swt/
License: Eclipse Public License Version 1.0 ("EPL"). A copy of the EPL is available at http://www.eclipse.org/legal/epl-v10.html
Including version 3.5 libraries for Windows, Mac, and Linux

DocBook CSS (DocBook XML Rendering with CSS)
  MozBook CSS (public domain, released by David Horton)
  WSIWYGDocBook 1.01 -- see demos\docbook\wysiwygdocbook1.01, and COPYING therein
  docbook-css-0.4 -- see demos\docbook\docbook-css-0.4, and COPYING therein

Xilize Text to HTML library
http://xilize.sourceforge.net/
License: GPL
Used version 3.x, only to produce documentation
Shipped with our source bundle as a convenience for developers rebuilding
documentation; we do not use nor link to the Xilize libraries at runtime

BeanShell
http://www.beanshell.org
License: LGPL (dual-license with SPL)
Use version 2.x as Xilize has a dependency on it; used only to produce
documentation.

XML-APIs (extracted from Apache Xerces-2)
http://xerces.apache.org/xerces2-j/
License: Apache v2
We include the xml-apis.jar from the Xerces binary distribution in order to allow
our code to compile on JDK 1.4, which does not include newer XML APIs, even though
these API implementations will run on version 1.4 of the JRE. The JAR is unmodified
from the Xerces release, but is renamed as xml-apis-xerces-2.9.1.jar to
make the version clear.
Included as lib/xml-apis-xerces-2.9.1.jar
